reason: Having had staff abandon Jamku and desktop ERP after two months, I will not pay ₹12,990 upfront for software that requires training article clerks who rotate every two to three years anyway. In a two-person office, I would rather spend two hours on Saturday reconciling GST or test the free pilot first than buy another system that gets discarded.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time if they end up abandoning it after two months.
would_change_my_mind: If a raw article clerk can handle filings from day one using the statutory blueprints with zero handholding, saving my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation consistently across a full quarterly cycle.
